globalAnalysis.visualFlow: The upright embracing figures descend into a flower meadow while a flat gold field suspends them outside ordinary space.
globalAnalysis.curatorialNote: Repeated gold is separated by meaning: empty gold becomes atmosphere, rectangular gold becomes geometry, and circular floral gold becomes organic motion.

cells.label: Distant golden field
cells.interpretation: Mostly empty gold creates distance and silence around the couple.

cells.label: Crown and patterned halo
cells.interpretation: Dark hair and compact ornaments gather above the figures like a ceremonial crown.

cells.label: Faces approaching
cells.interpretation: The lovers' heads lean together at the painting's emotional center.

cells.label: Golden stillness
cells.interpretation: Uninterrupted gold holds the figures in a quiet timeless surround.

cells.label: Left golden void
cells.interpretation: Open gold leaves acoustic and visual space beside the bodies.

cells.label: Man's rectangular cloak
cells.interpretation: Rigid repeated blocks descend through the man's cloak and create structural rhythm.

cells.label: The embrace
cells.interpretation: Overlapping hands and curved bodies compress the scene into a held intimate gesture.

cells.label: Right golden silence
cells.interpretation: A quiet gold margin separates the embrace from the outer edge.

cells.label: Gold beside the figures
cells.interpretation: Gold touches the long silhouette but remains visually open and restrained.

cells.label: Cloak's descending blocks
cells.interpretation: The repeated blocks create a stepped downward visual contour.

cells.label: Woman's circular gown
cells.interpretation: Colored circles rotate through the gown as an organic counterpoint to the man's blocks.

cells.label: Gold at the cliff edge
cells.interpretation: The gold field narrows where the body approaches the flowered ground.

cells.label: Blue-violet meadow
cells.interpretation: Dense blue, violet, and green flowers spread outward across the ground.

cells.label: Dense flower carpet
cells.interpretation: Numerous tiny blossoms create rapid visual events and lively organic density.

cells.label: Gown dissolving into flowers
cells.interpretation: The patterned garment loosens into the flower meadow below.

cells.label: Meadow fading into gold
cells.interpretation: Scattered flowers thin into the surrounding gold at the edge of the image.
